baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic prohibition in فلا تحسبن governs the judgment مخلف وعده.
baseline_models.mechanism: ح س ب/B002 supplies a fallible estimate and خ ل ف/B005 names a promise missing its due performance; the verse blocks the observer from converting apparent delay into a verdict of default.

activation_trace.role: Supposition or inward estimation supplies the mistaken cognitive operation being prohibited.
A promise not occurring at its due time supplies the precise failure wrongly attributed to God.
A spoken commitment opening expectation supplies the still-live obligation whose performance is in question.

changed_reading.before: Do not think that God breaks His promise.
changed_reading.after: Do not enter visible delay as evidence that the still-live divine commitment has defaulted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وعده رسله binds the promise to the messengers, and عزيز ذو انتقام supplies its enforcing side.
baseline_models.mechanism: The promise opens hope for its messenger-addressees while the threat and punitive branches face those who oppose them; invincible force makes vindication and requital two sides of one enforceable commitment.

activation_trace.role: The commitment that opens expectation supplies the messengers' promised outcome.
Carriers of the message supply the persons to whom the commitment is attached.
Prevailing over an opponent supplies the power that turns assurance into vindication.
Punishment following rejection supplies the adverse performance against the messengers' opponents.

changed_reading.before: God will keep a promise made to His messengers.
changed_reading.after: God's promise is an enforceable relation: it vindicates the message-bearers by prevailing over and requiting resistance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing predication combines عزيز with possession of انتقام.
baseline_models.mechanism: ع ز ز/B003 makes the agent difficult to reach or counter, while ن ق م/B002 places punitive response in His possession; nonperformance cannot be forced by an external challenger.

activation_trace.role: Rarity and difficulty of access supply immunity from being reached or constrained.
Owned capacity to punish supplies active recourse rather than bare remoteness.

changed_reading.before: Might is a general divine attribute appended to the assurance.
changed_reading.after: The assurance names an executor whom no resisting party can reach, disable, or deprive of recourse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural رسله stands beside the denied failure مخلف.
baseline_models.mechanism: ر س ل/B001 and B005 picture launch and successive groups, while خ ل ف/B005 supplies a missed future performance; together they permit a focus-only image of a messenger relay in which no dispatched cohort's promised outcome drops out.

activation_trace.role: Sending and release supply the initiating motion of the messenger mission.
Successive groups supply continuity across the plural messengers.
Failure of a future undertaking supplies the denied possibility that one part of the relay ends without performance.

changed_reading.before: Each messenger receives an isolated assurance.
changed_reading.after: The verse protects the continuity of a plural dispatch: no messenger-stage is abandoned before its promised issue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The threatened expulsion of the messengers is answered by emphatic destruction of the wrongdoers and emphatic resettlement after them. The promise in 14:47 therefore carries a concrete reversal: those marked for removal become the settled successors.

activation_trace.role: The message-carriers supply the beneficiaries of the reversed outcome.
Passage forcibly to the outside supplies the opponents' intended displacement of the messengers.
Falling into destruction supplies the answering removal of the wrongdoers.
Taking up residence supplies the positive replacement of expulsion with settlement.
Threat directed toward evil supplies the punitive half of the announced reversal.

structural_cues: 14:13-14 pairs the opponents' emphatic expulsion threat with the divine emphatic futures لنهلكن and لنسكننكم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expulsion, destruction, resettlement, and threat; I infer that the promise's causal shape is role reversal. A live alternative is that these are one historical instance rather than the full scope of 14:47.

changed_reading.before: The messengers receive an unspecified eventual vindication.
changed_reading.after: The promise overturns attempted displacement: the expellers are removed and the threatened messengers are established after them.

context_deltas.mechanism: 14:22 places God's true promise and Satan's admitted failed promise in one explicit contrast. The denial of مخلف in 14:47 is thus not merely abstract impeccability but the marked opposite of a counterfeit promisor who solicits trust and then defaults.

activation_trace.role: Repeated spoken commitments place the divine and satanic promises in direct comparison.
Truth fixed to reality marks the divine commitment as performance-bearing.
The speaker's admitted failure to perform supplies the counterfeit against which 14:47 denies divine default.
The same failure image is explicitly excluded from God.

structural_cues: Within 14:22, وعد الحق and فأخلفتكم are coordinated as opposing outcomes before 14:47 repeats the promise-failure lexicon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a true divine promise and an admitted satanic default; I infer that 14:47 recalls this internal antithesis. It could instead be an independent reassurance using common vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies promise-breaking in isolation.
changed_reading.after: The verse distinguishes the reality-bearing divine commitment from persuasive counter-promises whose speakers abandon their hearers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good word is rooted, fixed, and yields its produce at each appointed interval. Applied back to وعد, this makes fulfillment organic but scheduled: an unseen interval can be maturation rather than failure.

activation_trace.role: The spoken commitment supplies the word whose eventual performance is being tested.
An intelligible lexical utterance supplies the verbal object that can be imaged as a tree.
Rootedness and firmness supply durable attachment beneath visible outcomes.
Continuance without displacement supplies the word's persistence through delay.
The yield of a tree or crop supplies observable fulfillment.
The proper time of a thing supplies an appointed rhythm rather than an arbitrary postponement.

structural_cues: 14:24-25 explicitly maps a good word onto a fixed-root tree that yields at every حين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the word-tree and timed fruit; I transfer that mechanism to the promise as a kind of word. The live alternative is that the tree comparison concerns faithful speech generally, not this promise specifically.

changed_reading.before: A promise is either performed immediately or appears endangered.
changed_reading.after: The promise is a rooted word whose hidden persistence issues in fruit at its proper time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prayer sequence spans descendants, a gift received in old age, divine hearing, and renewed petition. It activates a generational clock for وعد: an answer may arrive late within one life and continue through dispersed offspring.

activation_trace.role: A promise bounded by a time supplies the question of when performance becomes visible.
Small particles spreading supply a material image for descendants extending an answer beyond one moment.
A gift without exchange supplies the realized answer received in old age.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies responsive reception rather than mere acoustic notice.
Calling by speech supplies the petition whose answer can unfold over generations.

structural_cues: 14:37-41 moves from descendants and provision to a gift in old age, heard prayer, renewed prayer, and the day of account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a long prayer-and-progeny sequence; I infer that it models delayed yet continuing performance. It may instead exemplify gratitude and petition without defining the promise in 14:47.

changed_reading.before: Delay is measured against the immediate horizon of the current messenger.
changed_reading.after: The promise can answer within a long life and continue through descendants, so its operative horizon is intergenerational.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans cannot enumerate divine benefit, then the first فلا تحسبن denies divine inattention and explicitly calls apparent delay postponement to a day; the second denies promise-default, and the sequence ends in swift حساب. The focus prohibition corrects a bad temporal ledger, not only a bad opinion.

activation_trace.role: Counting item by item supplies the human attempt to total divine action.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies the totalization humans are said not to achieve.
The repeated act of supposing links the earlier warning directly to the focus command.
Lapse that leaves something outside alert attention supplies the first false diagnosis of delay.
Deferral to a later time supplies the packet's explicit replacement for the diagnosis of neglect.
A bounded duration supplies the scheduled horizon of the deferral.
Counting and reckoning activate the focus command as a correction to the observer's ledger.
Matching action with its recompense supplies the entries the final account settles.
Swift accounting supplies the completed divine reckoning that overturns premature human calculation.

structural_cues: 14:42 and 14:47 repeat لا تحسبن الله; 14:42 names postponement to a day, while 14:51 closes with سريع الحساب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed human enumeration, twin prohibitions, explicit postponement, and final accounting; I infer a temporal-ledger mechanism. The live alternative is that ح س ب in the prohibitions remains only ordinary supposition, with حساب functioning independently.

changed_reading.before: The observer merely holds a mistaken belief that delay means breach.
changed_reading.after: The observer has closed the ledger too early: postponement is a scheduled open entry that divine recompense and swift accounting will settle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human plotting is framed at the scale of dislodging mountains; immediately after the focus assurance, earth and heavens are replaced and all emerge before the Overpowering One. The promise is the invariant, while even the apparently solid world may be changed to perform it.

activation_trace.role: Nonperformance of the commitment supplies the change explicitly ruled out.
Compacted hard ground supplies a material image of firmness at the hinge between mountains and replaced earth.
Displacement from place or state supplies the maximal effect attributed to hostile plotting.
A high solid mass supplies the benchmark of created stability that plotting is imagined to move.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the actual cosmic transformation after the assurance.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the material order that is replaceable.
Overpowering from above supplies the agency capable of changing the world without changing the commitment.

structural_cues: The contiguous 14:46-48 sequence moves from plots that might shift mountains, through the no-breach assurance, to actual replacement of earth and heavens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies imagined mountain-displacement and actual cosmic replacement around 14:47; I infer that the verse contrasts mutable creation with an invariant promise. The alternative is a simple escalation of power imagery with no invariant-versus-medium distinction.

changed_reading.before: Promise-keeping means preserving the current order until an outcome occurs within it.
changed_reading.after: Divine fidelity can preserve the word by replacing the world: creation is the mutable medium of an invariant commitment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence binds the offenders and states the purpose as recompensing every self for exactly what it earned, followed by swift accounting. ذو انتقام is thereby sharpened from undifferentiated punitive force into an administered settlement matching deed and return.

activation_trace.role: Moral rejection and blame supply the judgment preceding punishment.
Punishment after rejection supplies the execution phase of the settlement.
Binding one thing to another supplies controlled custody of the offenders.
Fastening in bonds supplies the concrete restraint through which judgment is administered.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies exact reciprocity.
Acquired gain supplies the deed-side against which each return is measured.
Swift calculation supplies the controlled completion of all reciprocal entries.

structural_cues: 14:49-51 proceeds from custody and punishment imagery to the explicit purpose clause ليجزي الله كل نفس ما كسبت and swift حساب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, earned action, matching recompense, and accounting; I infer that these specify how انتقام operates. A live alternative retains a stronger affective or adversarial sense alongside this forensic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Possession of vengeance means overwhelming punitive anger.
changed_reading.after: Possession of vengeance includes the capacity to bring each rejected wrong into exact, deed-matched settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah calls the discourse a delivery to people and gives its effects as warning, knowing divine unity, and remembering. This extends promise-to-messengers beyond their personal rescue: the dispatched message reaches its audience and performs its revelatory work.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and release supply the mission's movement outward.
The bearer and carried communication supply the human and verbal sides of the mission.
Arrival at the endpoint supplies successful completion of the dispatch.
Conveyance of a message supplies the explicit communicative completion.
Warning that awakens caution supplies one intended effect of arrival.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic effect of the delivered message.
Divine unity without partner supplies the content that successful delivery makes known.

structural_cues: 14:52 closes the surah by naming this a بلاغ and coordinating three purpose clauses for warning, knowledge, and remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch imagery in رسل and a final message reaching people; I infer that mission-efficacy belongs within the promised vindication. The alternative restricts the promise to rescue and punishment while treating 14:52 as a separate conclusion.

changed_reading.before: The promise concerns what will happen to the messengers and their enemies.
changed_reading.after: The promise also secures what happens through the messengers: their dispatched communication arrives, warns, discloses unity, and becomes remembrance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ع د د target for focus و ع د rather than the ordinary promise branch. It remains packet-anchored through root_000989/B002 and is activated by provision and counting in 14:32-34; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for readiness, never as a lexical replacement for وعد.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory explicitly gives و ع د a split target at root_000989, whose B002 image is preparing equipment or a reserve.

activation_trace.role: A reserve prepared for a coming event supplies an image of fulfillment already provisioned before it appears.
An apportioned gift supplies concrete provision drawn from the prepared reserve.
Enumeration of supplied benefits activates the same mapped root's accounting field.

changed_reading.before: The promise is future speech awaiting later resources for execution.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the promise resembles an already prepared reserve from which its future performance is provisioned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant cross-domain activation from the packet's ع و م target for focus و ع د. It remains anchored by that supplied split mapping, the dispatch branches of رسل, and the boat-current-arrival sequence; downstream prose should mark it as a process image, not claim that وعد lexically means swimming or current.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory maps و ع د also to root_001063, where B001 images swimming or smooth current-like travel, beside رسل images of dispatch and successive groups.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or current-like travel supplies a directional process image for the promise moving through history.
Successive dispatched groups supply the repeated vessels carried by that process.
A vessel moving in water supplies the carrier within the directional medium.
Continuous flowing motion supplies progress despite no immediate view of the endpoint.
Reaching the goal supplies the assured endpoint of the current-like process.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a static guarantee attached separately to individual messengers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a historical current carrying successive messenger-dispatches toward assured arrival.

strongest_changes: The expulsion-resettlement sequence makes the promise a concrete reversal that establishes the threatened messengers after removing their oppressors.
The true-promise versus failed-promise contrast in 14:22 gives مخلف an internal counterfeit against which divine fidelity is read.
The paired لا تحسبن commands, explicit postponement, and swift final حساب turn apparent delay into an open accounting interval rather than breach.
The post-focus purpose clause sharpens انتقام into exact recompense for what each self acquired, while the final بلاغ extends vindication to successful message-delivery.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context linked the focus ayah's promise vocabulary to repeated dispatch, historical reversal, timed fruition, prayer across generations, explicit counter-promises, scheduled accounting, cosmic replacement, exact recompense, and final arrival of the message.
remaining_uncertainties: The conventional promise-failure construction remains primary; replacement, prepared-reserve, and current images are branch-triggered analogies rather than substitute translations.
The promise may jointly include worldly establishment, final judgment, and efficacy of the message, but the trace does not collapse those live scopes into one referent.
Exact repayment strongly disciplines ذو انتقام, though a more affective or adversarial punitive force remains live beside the forensic reading.
